{{Top|leg}}
A '''molleung worm''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] bio-creation that was used as a cofferdam in both [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and [[Water/Legends|underwater]]. In the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the worm released cargo from a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to an on-world complex. In the water, the worm was used to link underwater chambers together. It is often used to attack troops prior to the landing of the transport. It can also assist troops in battle.
